light-domain.summary: A cleric of radiance and revelation who scorches foes with fire and light and shields allies with flashes of glare.

Light Domain Spells.summary: Fire, light and seeing spells join your prepared list for free at Cleric levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (see the domain spell list).

Radiance of the Dawn.summary: Magic action, spend a Channel Divinity use: dispel magical Darkness in a 30-ft Emanation, and chosen creatures there make a CON save, taking 2d10 + Cleric level Radiant (half on a success).

Warding Flare.summary: Reaction: give Disadvantage to an attack roll made by a creature you see within 30 ft. WIS mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

Improved Warding Flare.summary: Warding Flare now refills on a Short or Long Rest, and each use can give the attack's target 2d6 + WIS mod temp HP.

Corona of Light.summary: Magic action: shed sunlight for 1 minute (60 ft bright, 30 ft more dim); enemies in the bright part have Disadvantage on saves against Radiance of the Dawn and your Fire or Radiant spells. WIS mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

trickery-domain.summary: A mischievous cleric of deception and stealth who fights through an illusory double.

Blessing of the Trickster.summary: Magic action: you or a willing creature within 30 ft gets Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until your next Long Rest or until you use this again.

Trickery Domain Spells.summary: Deception, stealth and mind spells join your prepared list for free at Cleric levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (see the domain spell list).

Invoke Duplicity.summary: Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity use: make an intangible illusion of yourself within 30 ft for 1 minute. Cast spells from its space, gain Advantage on foes next to both of you, and move it 30 ft as a Bonus Action.

options.name: Cast Spells
options.summary: Cast spells as if standing where the illusion is, using your own senses.

options.name: Distract
options.summary: Advantage on attacks against a creature that sees the illusion when you and it are both within 5 ft of that creature.

options.name: Move
options.summary: Bonus Action: shift the illusion up to 30 ft to a space you see within 120 ft.

Trickster’s Transposition.summary: When you use the Bonus Action to create or move your Invoke Duplicity illusion, you can also teleport to swap places with it.

Improved Duplicity.summary: You and allies get Advantage attacking creatures within 5 ft of your illusion, and when it ends, you or someone within 5 ft of it heals HP equal to your Cleric level.

options.name: Shared Distraction
options.summary: Attack rolls by you and your allies against a creature within 5 ft of the illusion have Advantage.

options.name: Healing Illusion
options.summary: As the illusion ends, you or a chosen creature within 5 ft of it regains HP equal to your Cleric level.

war-domain.summary: A battle priest who makes extra attacks, guides strikes home and channels divinity into combat spells.

Guided Strike.summary: Spend a Channel Divinity use to add +10 to a missed attack roll by you or a creature within 30 ft; helping someone else costs your Reaction.

War Domain Spells.summary: Combat and protection spells join your prepared list for free at Cleric levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (see the domain spell list).

War Priest.summary: Bonus Action: one attack with a weapon or Unarmed Strike. WIS mod uses (min 1), back on a Short or Long Rest.

War God’s Blessing.summary: Pay a Channel Divinity use in place of a slot for Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon. Then it skips Concentration and runs 1 minute, ending early if you recast it, become Incapacitated or die.

Avatar of Battle.summary: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
